chapter: Science Chapter 12 – Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
scope_note: 9 items are identified as enrichment/extension rather than core CBSE requirements.

changes.reason: Updated the nominal Indian single-phase supply voltage to 230 V while acknowledging the older 220 V textbook convention. Official supply-code material specifies 230 V phase-to-neutral and 50 Hz.
Replaced an ambiguous geometric description with the well-defined field direction and local pattern at the loop centre.
Removed the implication that the geomagnetic pole is exactly at the geographic pole; clarified magnetic declination.

Corrected the answer key and explanation. The original explanation applied Fleming’s left-hand rule inconsistently: upward conventional current crossed with an eastward field gives force North, not South.
Avoided the unsafe blanket claim that all plastic-cased appliances are double-insulated; specified the protection class.
Corrected the over-precise geographic alignment claim and accounted for magnetic declination.
Removed the misleading implication that Alnico is the uniquely typical choice for modern loudspeakers; retained the correct material concept.
Rewrote the item and corrected its answer. The original “All of the above” grouped short circuiting with overloading and treated a voltage surge as an unconditional cause.
Qualified “completely uniform” to account for finite solenoid end effects.
Removed absolute claims that earthing makes user contact harmless or always trips a breaker instantly; specified protective-device operation.
Updated nominal voltage to 230 V and clarified the meaning of frequency and direction reversals.
Removed an outdated fixed 220 V figure and refined the safety explanation without changing the correct concept.
Removed the physically over-absolute claim that residual magnetism is virtually zero and disappears instantly.
Scoped the claim to EDS Maglev and removed the inaccurate implication that all Maglev systems use the same arrangement or have no resistance at all.
Removed the guarantee of an immediate trip and made clear that the appliance must be repaired; protective-device operation depends on installation.

sources: NCERT Class X Science Chapter 12 for core magnetic effects, motor, induction and domestic circuit concepts
